title: Pushing Fifty
html:
Quest Giver: Doctor Whom the Eleventh

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Equip the headbucket. Spar with any 25 partners in Level 6 of MutantMania. As you get the snot beat out of you, collect 50 boogers. Return all boogers AND the headbucket to Doctor Whom the Eleventh in that same level.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Doctor Whom the Eleventh

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Equip the headbucket. Spar with any 25 partners in Level 6 of MutantMania. As you get the snot beat out of you, collect 50 boogers. Return all boogers AND the headbucket to Doctor Whom the Eleventh in that same level.

Offer:

Each time I give you a check-up, my--we'll call them experiments--my experiments move foward a bit more. But, I think I've mentioned that before. Haven't I? There's so much I forget to mention to my victi...helpers. My helpers.

We'll proceed the same as last time. First, I need you to check your heart rate. Get out there and spar with enough people to get your ticker pumping. How many partners did I ask for last time? Never mind. Let's try 25 this time.

Also, I will need another fluids test, so make sure to get the snot beat out of you again by your new partners! Here is a new bucket for your head. Put it on, but, as always, I want my bucket *back* after the tests! Now, go anywhere in level 6 and get the snot beat out of you. My new tests need...hmmm...50 boogers.

After I get the boogers and my bucket back from you, I have a special surprise for you.

Turn-in:

Very nice, very nice...these new boogers will go perfect in my soup...test tubes. Perfect in my test tubes.

Stand still now while I give you a booster shot. For the next few minutes, it'll help you be resistant to poisons, toxins, yadda yadda, blah blah blah.

Objectives:

  • Bucket ×1
  • ''Spar'' with 25 Partners
  • Boogers ×50

Level range: 88–98
